news.title: Winter Break Extended
content: Due to ongoing construction work in the main building, winter break has been extended by one week. Classes will resume on June 15, 2025.
All students and parents are requested to take note of this change. The school administration apologizes for any inconvenience caused and appreciates your understanding.

news.title: Annual Sports Day 2025
content: Our Annual Sports Day will be held on June 20, 2025, at the school grounds. This year's theme is "Unity in Diversity" celebrating our multicultural student body.
Registration forms are available at the school office. Parents are cordially invited to attend and cheer for their children. Various competitions and cultural programs are planned.

news.title: New Science Laboratory Inauguration
content: We are excited to announce the inauguration of our new state-of-the-art science laboratory equipped with modern instruments and safety equipment.
The facility will be open for students from Class 8 onwards starting next week. Special orientation sessions will be conducted for students and teachers.

news.title: Library Digital Upgrade
content: Our school library has been upgraded with new digital resources including e-books, online databases, and computer workstations.
Students can now access thousands of digital books and research materials. New library cards will be issued starting next week.

news.title: School Uniform Update
content: Starting from the new academic session, there will be slight modifications to the school uniform policy.
The updated uniform guidelines have been sent to all parents via email. Please ensure compliance by June 20, 2025.

news.title: Summer Camp Registration Open
content: Registration for our annual Summer Camp 2025 is now open! The camp will run from July 1-15, 2025.
Activities include arts & crafts, sports, swimming, and educational workshops. Limited seats available. Register at the school office or online through our portal.
